source.body:
### Bug Description

In the global executions list, the mode column shows an icon with a tooltip for manual and chat executions. Both tooltips are hardcoded English: "Manual Execution" and "Chat Execution".

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/execution/executions/components/global/GlobalExecutionsListItem.vue#L281-L286

All other text in this component uses `locale.baseText`, including the private credential tooltip in the same table cell.

### To Reproduce

1. Switch the instance UI to a language other than English.
2. Run a workflow manually from the editor.
3. Open the **Executions** page from the sidebar.
4. Hover the flask icon in the mode column. The tooltip reads "Manual Execution" in English.

The chat icon has the same problem. It shows for executions started from **Chat** in the sidebar.

### Expected behavior

Both tooltips use i18n keys and show in the active language.

### Debug Info

Found by reading the source on `master` (version `2.44.0`). The strings are hardcoded in the component, so this does not depend on the instance setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.44.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a PR ready for this.
